title: Klikety Configuration
description: Configuration file for Klikety keyboard-driven mouse navigator. Supports JSON with Comments (JSONC).

$schema.description: Path to this schema file. Enables editor IntelliSense.

hotKey.description: Global hotkey that activates the navigation overlay.

modifiers.description: Modifier key combination. Comma-separated flags: Alt, Control, Shift, Win.

key.description: The trigger VKey name (physical key code, layout-independent).

actionBindings.description: Maps VKey names to mouse actions. Space → LeftClick is always the implicit default even if omitted.

horizontalKeys.description: Horizontal axis VKey list (selects grid column). Shared by all navigation modes.

verticalKeys.description: Vertical axis VKey list (selects grid row). Shared by all navigation modes.

level3CellSizeThreshold.description: Physical pixel² area threshold for level-3 auto-activation. When a level-2 cell exceeds this area, a third navigation level becomes available. Default 0 = always active.

logLevel.description: Minimum log level written to %APPDATA%\Klikety\logs\. Uses Microsoft.Extensions.Logging level names.

navigationMode.description: Legacy. Migrated to modes.uniformGrid.twoKey/arrowKeys on first load. Kept for backward compatibility.

modes.description: Navigation modes. Each mode can be independently enabled/disabled. Exactly one must be default. N, M, and OemComma are default chord keys — do not use in action bindings.

uniformGrid.description: Standard uniform grid mode. Uses firstKeys/secondKeys for two-key navigation.

crosshair.description: Crosshair mode. Bisects screen along horizontal/vertical axes.

logCrosshair.description: Logarithmic crosshair mode. Like crosshair but with log-scaled center cell.

logBaseSize.description: Base cell size in physical pixels for the center cell.

logGrid.description: Logarithmic grid mode. Iterative two-key selection with log-scaled center cell and recentering.

logGridBaseSize.description: Base cell size in physical pixels for the LogGrid center cell.

configVersion.description: Config format version. Set automatically by migration. Do not change manually.

theme.description: Theme name (resolves to themes/<name>.theme.json) or relative path from the config folder. Must have .theme.json extension if a path.

fileLoggingEnabled.description: Enable file logging to %APPDATA%\Klikety\logs\. When false, no log folder is created.

retainedLogFileCount.description: Maximum number of rolling log files to keep. Oldest files are deleted when this count is exceeded. Only applies when fileLoggingEnabled is true.

minLabelFontSize.description: Minimum label font size in DIP. When subgrid cells are too small for labels at this size, labels render outside the grid with connector lines.

scrollHotkeys.description: Global scroll hotkeys. Send mouse wheel events at current cursor position. Disabled by default.

scrollUpKey.description: Hotkey for scrolling up. Default: Ctrl+Alt+PageUp.

scrollDownKey.description: Hotkey for scrolling down. Default: Ctrl+Alt+PageDown.

scrollAmount.description: Number of wheel notches per hotkey press. Each notch = WHEEL_DELTA (120).

keyPressVisualization.description: Visual settings for the key press display HUD. Feature is toggled at runtime via tray menu (always off after restart).

fontSize.description: Font size in DIP for key labels.

outlineColor.description: Stroke color for key label outlines (hex).

fadeTimeoutMs.description: Milliseconds of inactivity before keys start fading.

fadeDurationMs.description: Duration of fade-out animation in milliseconds.

maxVisibleKeys.description: Maximum number of key entries displayed simultaneously.

margin.description: Margin from screen edge in DIP.

repeatWindowMs.description: Time window in milliseconds for collapsing repeated identical keys.

hotKeyConfig.description: A hotkey: modifier combination + trigger key.

modifiers.description: Modifier key combination. Comma-separated flags: Alt, Control, Shift, Win.

key.description: The trigger VKey name (physical key code, layout-independent).

default.description: Whether this mode activates on overlay open. Exactly one mode must be default.

chordKey.description: VKey that switches to this mode while overlay is active. Not needed for the default mode.

arrowKeys.description: Enable arrow-key navigation within this mode.

twoKey.description: Enable two-key (column+row) navigation within this mode.
